required_clauses.name: Parties & Identity Clause
required_clauses.description: Names, Aadhaar/PAN, addresses, and identities of Lessor and Lessee
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: You must clearly know who the legal owner is so an unauthorized third party doesn't take your deposit money.

required_clauses.name: Description of Demised Premises
required_clauses.description: Complete address, unit number, boundaries, parking slot, and fixtures included
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Protects you from landlord disputing parking rights or claiming furniture was missing or damaged.

required_clauses.name: Lease Term, Due Date & Rent Escalation Cap
required_clauses.description: Exact lease tenure (e.g., 11 months), monthly rent amount, monthly due date (e.g. 5th), grace period, and annual rent hike ceiling (max 5-10%)
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Prevents the landlord from arbitrarily increasing rent mid-stay or charging surprise late penalties without a grace period.

required_clauses.name: Interest-Free Security Deposit & Refund Timeline
required_clauses.description: Refundable security deposit amount, explicit 7-14 days refund timeline, and clause requiring itemized repair bills for any deductions
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Stops landlords from illegally withholding your deposit or deducting imaginary painting/damage charges without receipts.

required_clauses.name: Utilities & Maintenance Charges Allocation
required_clauses.description: Electricity, water, society maintenance allocation and structural repair responsibility of landlord
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Ensures structural building repairs (seepage, plumbing leaks) are paid by the owner, not the tenant.

required_clauses.name: Termination & Notice Period (Min 30 Days)
required_clauses.description: Mutual notice period (at least 30 days) for vacating or terminating, prohibiting sudden immediate eviction
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Guarantees you cannot be thrown out onto the street without at least 30 days prior written notice.

required_clauses.name: Landlord Inspection Notice (24-Hour Notice Rule)
required_clauses.description: Landlord right of entry strictly subject to 24 hours prior notice and reasonable daytime hours
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Protects your family's personal privacy so the landlord cannot enter your home unannounced.

required_clauses.name: Mandatory Registration Compliance (If Tenure > 11 Months)
required_clauses.description: Mandatory Sub-Registrar registration under Section 17 of Indian Registration Act if tenure is 12 months or longer
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Any lease for 1 year or more MUST be registered at the Sub-Registrar office, otherwise it is void and cannot be used in court.

required_clauses.name: Dispute Resolution & Local Jurisdiction
required_clauses.description: Courts having exclusive jurisdiction located in the local district / state where the property is situated
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Ensures any legal dispute is fought in your local city civil court, not in a far-off distant state.

required_clauses.name: Governing Law & State Tenancy Protection
required_clauses.description: Subject to laws of India and applicable State Tenancy Acts
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Ensures statutory tenant protections under Indian tenancy laws apply to your contract.

required_clauses.name: Scope of Work & Deliverables
required_clauses.description: Precise specifications, milestones, and acceptance criteria
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Prevents client scope creep where you do extra unpaid work.

required_clauses.name: Payment Terms & Invoicing
required_clauses.description: Milestone payments, invoice cycle, taxes (GST), and late payment interest
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Guarantees you get paid on time with interest for late client payments.

required_clauses.name: Confidentiality & Non-Disclosure
required_clauses.description: Protection of proprietary trade secrets, data, and technical know-how
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Keeps your company's business secrets and methods confidential.

required_clauses.name: Intellectual Property Ownership
required_clauses.description: Work-for-hire assignment or licensing terms
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Defines who owns the code, design, or deliverable created.

required_clauses.name: Limitation of Liability (Damages Cap)
required_clauses.description: Cap on aggregate damages and exclusion of consequential losses
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Caps your legal financial risk to the total fees earned so you don't face bankruptcy.

required_clauses.name: Mutual Indemnification
required_clauses.description: Third-party IP infringement and negligence indemnity limits
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Ensures both sides protect each other mutually instead of only you paying for everything.

required_clauses.name: Termination for Cause & Convenience
required_clauses.description: Cure period for breach and rights upon immediate termination
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Gives you at least 15-30 days to fix any innocent mistake before contract is cancelled.

required_clauses.name: Arbitration & Dispute Resolution
required_clauses.description: Arbitration clause under Arbitration & Conciliation Act 1996
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Allows resolving disputes quickly through an arbitrator instead of 10 years in court.

required_clauses.name: Governing Law & Jurisdiction
required_clauses.description: Applicable laws and seat of arbitration
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Sets the legal rules and local city court for disputes.

required_clauses.name: Designation, Duties & Reporting
required_clauses.description: Job title, principal duties, reporting authority
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Ensures employer cannot arbitrarily change your core job duties to something unrelated.

required_clauses.name: Salary, CTC & Benefits Breakdown
required_clauses.description: Breakdown of basic salary, allowances, statutory PF/ESI, deductions
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Protects your take-home pay and ensures provident fund and medical benefits are deposited.

required_clauses.name: Probation Period & Confirmation Terms
required_clauses.description: Evaluation duration and terms of confirmation
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Clearly sets the trial period so company cannot keep you on probation forever.

required_clauses.name: Confidential Information & Trade Secrets
required_clauses.description: Non-disclosure obligations during and post employment
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Sets guidelines on handling confidential client and company data.

required_clauses.name: Assignment of Inventions & IP
required_clauses.description: Employer ownership of employee creations during duty
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Clarifies that work created during employment belongs to the employer.

required_clauses.name: Reasonable Non-Solicitation
required_clauses.description: Reasonable restriction on poaching staff or clients
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Under Indian Contract Act Section 27, post-employment non-competes are void; only reasonable non-solicitation is valid.

required_clauses.name: Notice Period & Severance (Min 30 Days)
required_clauses.description: Notice period or pay in lieu, summary dismissal conditions
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Ensures you are given 30 days notice or salary if laid off.

required_clauses.name: Dispute Resolution & Jurisdiction
required_clauses.description: Local jurisdiction for employment disputes
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Ensures labor disputes are handled in your local city labor court.

required_clauses.name: Definition of Confidential Information
required_clauses.description: Clear enumeration of proprietary information covered
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Clearly defines what information must be kept secret.

required_clauses.name: Standard of Care & Non-Disclosure Obligations
required_clauses.description: Duty to safeguard, need-to-know restriction
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Specifies how confidential documents must be guarded.

required_clauses.name: Standard Exclusions from Confidentiality
required_clauses.description: Public domain, prior knowledge, independent development exceptions
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Ensures you are not punished for information that was already public or known.

required_clauses.name: Duration of Confidentiality (Capped Term)
required_clauses.description: Term of agreement and survival period (e.g., 2-3 years)
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Ensures confidentiality doesn't bind you endlessly forever.

required_clauses.name: Return or Destruction of Materials
required_clauses.description: Written certification of deletion upon termination
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Clear process to delete data when the partnership ends.

required_clauses.name: Injunctive Relief & Remedies
required_clauses.description: Right to seek injunctions without proof of special damages
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Allows stopping unauthorized leaks immediately via court order.

required_clauses.name: Governing Law & Courts
required_clauses.description: Choice of law and court jurisdiction
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Specifies applicable state laws.

required_clauses.name: Preamble & Identity of Parties
required_clauses.description: Valid corporate/individual legal entities
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Confirms the exact legal names and authorized signers.

required_clauses.name: Consideration & Performance Obligations
required_clauses.description: Clear reciprocal promises and consideration
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Under Section 10/25 of Indian Contract Act, every valid contract must have clear consideration.

required_clauses.name: Representations & Warranties
required_clauses.description: Authority to enter contract and legal capacity
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Guarantees both sides have the legal right and power to sign.

required_clauses.name: Limitation of Liability Cap
required_clauses.description: Damages cap and mutual liability parameters
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Puts a safe ceiling on maximum damages you could ever owe.

required_clauses.name: Term and Termination with Cure Period
required_clauses.description: Expiration, termination with/without breach
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Ensures fair exit rights with reasonable notice.

required_clauses.name: Force Majeure (Acts of God & Epidemics)
required_clauses.description: Unforeseeable events beyond reasonable control
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Protects you from penalties if floods, earthquakes, or government lockdowns stop performance.

required_clauses.name: Dispute Resolution Mechanism
required_clauses.description: Conciliation, mediation or arbitration before court
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Specifies mediation or arbitration before costly court trials.

required_clauses.name: Governing Law & Jurisdiction
required_clauses.description: Applicable state laws and competent court seat
required_clauses.why_needed_in_plain_words: Ensures cases are heard in your home state courts.
